a.lede: N-able has taken its hosted N-central environments offline and urged on-premises customers to shut down their servers after a security researcher publicly disclosed more than 30 alleged zero-day vulnerabilities, including exploits that could let attackers take over vulnerable systems. [...]
a.title: N-able takes cloud platform offline after 30+ "zero-days" published

b.lede: Check Point Software has released emergency hotfixes to address a high-severity flaw that hackers have been exploiting to gain root privileges and establish persistence on vulnerable devices since late October. [...]
b.title: Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
